messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood — disclosure deadline next week
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on the Calderwood litigation (not Granite): the standard disclosure deadline under the CMC order is next Thursday 27 November. Counsel (Catherine Rosenthal KC) has asked for the updated disclosure index and the schedule of loss by Monday so she can finalise her advice. Elena has the index nearly there — are you happy for me to send it straight to chambers once it's signed off?

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
